## Instructional Gap

::: {.incremental}
1. Install Python
1. Edit code -> save -> go to terminal -> run -> repeat
1. `input()` is harder than it looks
1. How many real programs use `input()`?
1. Learn to write correct syntax to solve problems
1. AI is a chat box
1. Which model is the best?
1. AI gave me code and it just works!
:::

## Unique Features

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width=30%}

- Variables owned by cells
    - Cell order irrelevant
    - Deterministic execution
    - Reproducible results
- Private variables: `_a = 5`
- Saved as `.py`
- Bring your own harness
- Publish with WASM
:::
::: {.column width=40%}
```{mermaid}
%%| fig-width: 4
flowchart TD
    A["a = 5"]
    B["b = 6"]
    C["c = a x b"]
    D["d = a ^ 2 + c"]
    A --> C
    B --> C
    A --> D
    C --> D
```
:::
::: {.column width=30%}

#### Prompt

> Help me to decompose a Sudoku solver in Python step-by-step

> Make the game print as a markdown table instead of plain string
:::
::::


## Running Locally

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width=50%}
#### How?

```sh
winget install astral-sh.uv # on Windows
dnf install uv # on Fedora Linux
brew install uv # on MacOS or Linux with Homebrew

uvx marimo edit new.py

uv tool install marimo
```
:::
::: {.column width=5%}
:::
::: {.column width=45%}
#### Why?

- ~~WASM~~ Native Runtime
    - More packages!
- Memory, hardware access
- Network Access
- Real AI integration!
:::
::::

## Which AI model to use?

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width=45%}
#### Ideal World

- Tokens are free and unlimited
- Frontier models everywhere
    - A hammer is all you need!
- Companies care about your privacy
:::
::: {.column width=10%}
:::
::: {.column width=45%}
#### Reality

- Students must experiment and discern
- Bring your own tokens
- "Claude" is not a model
    - Understand what works when!
- [The lethal trifecta](https://simonwillison.net/2025/Jun/16/the-lethal-trifecta/)
:::
